#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""obfuscate.py — SQLi payload mutators for in-house WAF signature regression."""

import random
import re

_SQL_KEYWORDS = (
    "SELECT", "UNION", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "DROP",
    "FROM", "WHERE", "AND", "OR", "ORDER", "GROUP", "HAVING",
    "JOIN", "INTO", "VALUES", "TABLE", "CONCAT", "SLEEP",
    "BENCHMARK", "INFORMATION_SCHEMA",
)

_COMMENT_STYLES = ("/**/", "/*!*/", "-- ", "#")


def insert_comments(p):
    """Insert SQL comment tokens inside keywords to break naive regexes."""
    out = p
    for kw in _SQL_KEYWORDS:
        pattern = re.compile(re.escape(kw), re.IGNORECASE)
        def _split(m, _kw=kw):
            mid = max(1, len(_kw) // 2)
            style = random.choice(_COMMENT_STYLES)
            return _kw[:mid] + style + _kw[mid:]
        out = pattern.sub(_split, out)
    return out


def vuln_case(p):
    """Randomize case of every character to defeat case-sensitive signatures."""
    return "".join(random.choice((c.lower(), c.upper())) for c in p)


def hex_encode_str(p):
    """Rewrite quoted string literals as 0xHHHH hex constants."""
    def _to_hex(m):
        raw = m.group(1).encode("utf-8")
        return "0x" + raw.hex()
    return re.sub(r"'([^']*)'", _to_hex, p)


def versioned_kw(p):
    """Wrap reserved words in MySQL versioned comments: /*!50000KEYWORD*/."""
    out = p
    for kw in _SQL_KEYWORDS:
        pattern = re.compile(r"\b" + re.escape(kw) + r"\b", re.IGNORECASE)
        out = pattern.sub(lambda m, _kw=kw: "/*!50000" + _kw + "*/", out)
    return out


def swap_operators(p):
    """Substitute logical operators: OR -> ||, AND -> &&."""
    out = re.sub(r"(?i)\bOR\b", "||", p)
    out = re.sub(r"(?i)\bAND\b", "&&", out)
    return out


def replace_ws(p):
    """Replace each space with one of tab / + / %0a, cycling through all three."""
    subs = ("\t", "+", "%0a")
    parts = p.split(" ")
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return p
    rebuilt = [parts[0]]
    for i, chunk in enumerate(parts[1:]):
        rebuilt.append(subs[i % 3])
        rebuilt.append(chunk)
    return "".join(rebuilt)


def null_terminate(p):
    """Append a NUL byte so some parsers truncate the remainder of the query."""
    return p + "\x00"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sample = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='admin' OR 1=1 AND role='root'"
    mutators = (
        insert_comments,
        vuln_case,
        hex_encode_str,
        versioned_kw,
        swap_operators,
        replace_ws,
        null_terminate,
    )
    print("original:", sample)
    for fn in mutators:
        mutated = fn(sample)
        print(f"{fn.__name__}: {mutated!r}")
